# AMEVA-MCP-Hub (v3.0.0)
> Zero-Install Universal Polyglot WASM & AI Vector Model Context Protocol Hub

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-mcp-hub
- Installation: `npx ameva-mcp-hub
# or as SDK:
npm install ameva-mcp-hub`
- Architecture: Executes WASI WebAssembly bytecodes in-memory inside a single Node process (<1ms execution) and enables live multi-repo subscription for AI tools.

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
